envelope.objective: pin the epic wave-barrier Layer 2 parity edge cases

cases.name: issue-num-reference-confirmed-before-start
cases.notes: An integer issue_num reference resolves through the union index; a confirmation earlier than the start is not a violation.

cases.name: issue-num-reference-confirmed-after-start
cases.notes: A confirmation later than the start is a timing violation that renders the raw integer reference.

cases.name: active-prefixed-hint-unmerged
cases.notes: A docs/features/active/ hint resolves after prefix normalization and renders the raw hint text.
expected_barrier_errors: EPIC_WAVE_BARRIER_VIOLATION: 2026-10-08-bravo-902 is treated as started while dependency docs/features/active/2026-10-08-alpha-901 is not merged

cases.name: completed-prefixed-hint-unmerged
cases.notes: A completed/ hint resolves after prefix normalization and renders the raw hint text.
expected_barrier_errors: EPIC_WAVE_BARRIER_VIOLATION: 2026-10-08-bravo-902 is treated as started while dependency completed/2026-10-08-alpha-901 is not merged

cases.name: unresolved-and-non-string-references-skipped
cases.notes: Unresolved strings and integers, a string against an integer issue_num, null, list, and object references are skipped.

cases.name: bool-reference-without-issue-num-one
cases.notes: A true reference resolves only to an issue_num equal to 1; with none it is skipped.

cases.name: bool-reference-matches-issue-num-one
cases.notes: A true reference matches issue_num 1 and renders as True.
expected_barrier_errors: EPIC_WAVE_BARRIER_VIOLATION: 2026-10-08-bravo-902 is treated as started while dependency True is not merged

cases.name: integer-reference-matches-bool-issue-num
cases.notes: An integer reference 1 matches an issue_num of true and renders as 1.
expected_barrier_errors: EPIC_WAVE_BARRIER_VIOLATION: 2026-10-08-bravo-902 is treated as started while dependency 1 is not merged

cases.name: integer-reference-against-string-issue-num
cases.notes: An integer reference never matches a string issue_num.

cases.name: skipped-malformed-entries
cases.notes: Non-object entries, a string depends_on, a non-string dependent folder, and an absent depends_on produce no error.

cases.name: features-is-an-object
cases.notes: A features value that is an object rather than a list yields no features.

cases.name: dependency-merge-status-integer
cases.notes: A non-string dependency merge_status is a status violation.
expected_barrier_errors: EPIC_WAVE_BARRIER_VIOLATION: 2026-10-08-bravo-902 is treated as started while dependency 2026-10-08-alpha-901 is not merged

cases.name: dependency-merge-status-case-variant
cases.notes: The merged-status comparison is case-sensitive.
expected_barrier_errors: EPIC_WAVE_BARRIER_VIOLATION: 2026-10-08-bravo-902 is treated as started while dependency 2026-10-08-alpha-901 is not merged

cases.name: dependency-merge-status-key-case-variant
cases.notes: A Merge_Status key is not merge_status, so the status is absent and the edge is a status violation.
expected_barrier_errors: EPIC_WAVE_BARRIER_VIOLATION: 2026-10-08-bravo-902 is treated as started while dependency 2026-10-08-alpha-901 is not merged

cases.name: equal-timestamps-no-violation
cases.notes: Equal confirmation and start strings are not a timing violation.

cases.name: lowercase-t-confirmation-orders-after-uppercase
cases.notes: Ordinal comparison places a lowercase t after an uppercase T.

cases.name: offset-timestamps-compare-as-strings
cases.notes: Timestamps compare as strings, so a chronologically later offset time that sorts earlier is not a violation.

cases.name: utc-timestamps-confirmation-later
cases.notes: ISO-8601 Z timestamps stay strings; a later confirmation is a timing violation.

cases.name: non-string-confirmations-skip-timing
cases.notes: A numeric or null merge_confirmed_at never produces a timing violation.

cases.name: empty-string-start-guard-timing
cases.notes: An empty worktree_created_at marks a not_started feature as started, and any confirmation string sorts after it.

cases.name: self-dependency-of-started-feature
cases.notes: A started feature that depends on itself reports a status violation naming itself.
expected_barrier_errors: EPIC_WAVE_BARRIER_VIOLATION: 2026-10-08-alpha-901 is treated as started while dependency 2026-10-08-alpha-901 is not merged

cases.name: duplicate-folder-later-record-merged
cases.notes: A later record with the same feature_folder replaces the earlier one.

cases.name: empty-dependent-folder
cases.notes: An empty dependent feature_folder is iterated and renders as an empty name.
expected_barrier_errors: EPIC_WAVE_BARRIER_VIOLATION:  is treated as started while dependency 2026-10-08-alpha-901 is not merged

cases.name: empty-string-dependency-never-resolves
cases.notes: An empty dependency string never resolves, even when a feature has an empty folder.

cases.name: negative-zero-integer-reference
cases.notes: A -0 reference matches issue_num 0 and renders as 0.
expected_barrier_errors: EPIC_WAVE_BARRIER_VIOLATION: 2026-10-08-bravo-902 is treated as started while dependency 0 is not merged

cases.name: integer-reference-beyond-int64
cases.notes: An integer beyond the 64-bit range matches and renders exactly.
expected_barrier_errors: EPIC_WAVE_BARRIER_VIOLATION: 2026-10-08-bravo-902 is treated as started while dependency 123456789012345678901234567890 is not merged

cases.name: status-violation-takes-precedence-over-timing
cases.notes: An unmerged dependency with a later confirmation reports only the status violation.
expected_barrier_errors: EPIC_WAVE_BARRIER_VIOLATION: 2026-10-08-bravo-902 is treated as started while dependency 2026-10-08-alpha-901 is not merged

cases.name: multiple-edges-reported-in-depends-on-order
cases.notes: Violations are reported in depends_on order, one per edge.
expected_barrier_errors: EPIC_WAVE_BARRIER_VIOLATION: 2026-10-08-bravo-902 is treated as started while dependency 2026-10-08-alpha-901 is not merged
